## Priority
**Nice-to-Have #10** - Lower priority, implement after must-haves

## Description
Implement marketing automation including email sequences, onboarding flows, and nurture campaigns to improve user engagement and conversion.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Email service provider integrated (SendGrid, Mailchimp)
- [ ] Welcome email sequence created
- [ ] Onboarding email flow implemented
- [ ] Re-engagement campaigns set up
- [ ] Email templates designed and tested
- [ ] Unsubscribe functionality working

## Email Sequences to Create

### Welcome Sequence
1. Welcome email (immediate)
2. Getting started guide (Day 1)
3. Tips and tricks (Day 3)
4. Success stories (Day 7)

### Onboarding Flow
1. Account confirmed
2. First content generated
3. Feature discovery
4. Upgrade prompt (for free users)

### Re-engagement
1. Haven't used in 7 days
2. Haven't used in 30 days
3. Win-back campaign

## Implementation Ideas
- Use SendGrid, Mailchimp, or Customer.io
- Segment users by behavior
- A/B test email copy and timing
- Track open rates and conversions
- Personalize based on industry/usage

## Metrics to Track
- Email open rate (>20%)
- Click-through rate (>3%)
- Conversion rate
- Unsubscribe rate (<0.5%)
